local_services.schema_per_case: fresh isolated schema; dropped at teardown

fault_scope.http: Real HTTP/1.1 loopback sockets; proxy forwards to actual in-process ASGI routes with JWT/HMAC and real PostgreSQL. Lost response closes socket after route commit.
fault_scope.process_restart: API lifespan and pools recreated; not an OS restart.
fault_scope.worker_acknowledgement: Injected failure before SQL delivery acknowledgement commit; original exception asserted; later eligible lease replay recovers.
fault_scope.stale_worker: Old worker returns work=True but its token-fenced UPDATE changes no durable delivery count after new ownership acknowledges.
fault_scope.fulfillment: Failure raised after transaction commit; same durable event/inbox ID replayed through fresh adapter.
fault_scope.ttl: Tests advance only their own lease or hold deadlines, and verify recovery never extends the hold. Not a measured live failover window.
